mapper.select: select id, update_time, update_user_name, code, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, source_id, source_type, source_code, sku_total, location_total from picking_lists where ${params.sqlMap.default} and source_type = #{params.sourceType} and is_deleted = false order by create_time desc, id desc

select pl.code, pl.warehouse_id, pl.warehouse_name, pl.source_code, pd.sku_no, pd.warehouse_location, pd.qty, pd.staging_location, pl.update_user_name, pl.update_time from picking_lists as pl left join public.picking_detail pd on pl.id = pd.main_id and pd.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and pl.source_type = #{params.sourceType} and pl.is_deleted = false order by pl.update_time desc, pl.id desc

select pl.id as id, pl.code as code, pl.source_id as sourceId, pl.source_code as sourceCode, pl.warehouse_id as warehouseId, pd.id as detailId, pd.sku_id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.warehouse_location as warehouseLocation, pd.qty as qty, pd.source_detail_id as sourceDetailId, pd.staging_location as stagingLocation, pd.picked_qty as pickedQty, pd.allocated_qty as allocatedQty, pd.is_out_stock as isOutStock from picking_lists as pl inner join public.picking_detail pd on pl.id = pd.main_id and pd.is_deleted = false where pl.is_deleted = false and pl.source_id in
#{id}
